calculation.description: Fade the latest completed-session return, magnifying the reversal signal when short-term volatility is elevated relative to its 20-day baseline; three-session smoothing reduces noise.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.049561; ICIR 0.142332; 762 dates), 2023-2024 (0.036249; ICIR 0.104045; 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (0.025911; ICIR 0.077320; 574 dates). Recent regime is weaker, so monitor drift. Five-day predictive power is positive but below the daily admission gate; ten-day decay is absent.
validation.universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; minimum 8 valid instruments per date
validation.gate: Passed absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840
